title: Trigonometric Ratios: sin, cos, tan and Their Reciprocals
seo_title: Grade 10 Trigonometric Ratios Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Definitions of the trigonometric functions sin θ, cos θ and tan θ in right-angled triangles; their reciprocals cosec θ, sec θ and cot θ; extend the definitions to 0° ≤ θ ≤ 360°.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 10 trigonometry worksheets: sin, cos, tan, their reciprocals, finding sides and angles, and the ratios on the Cartesian plane. 100 questions with memos.
key_sub: On the Cartesian plane: y/r, x/r, y/x.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • sin θ = oppositehypotenuse, cos θ = adjacenthypotenuse, tan θ = oppositeadjacent.
  • The reciprocals: cosec θ = 1/sin θ, sec θ = 1/cos θ, cot θ = 1/tan θ.
  • On the Cartesian plane: sin θ = y/r, cos θ = x/r, tan θ = y/x, with r = √(x² + y²).
  • Use sin⁻¹, cos⁻¹ or tan⁻¹ to find an angle.

Examples

Example

P(−3; 4): find cos θ

r = √(9 + 16) = 5

Answer: cos θ = −3/5

Common mistakes

Opposite or adjacentOpposite is across from θ.
× or ÷x on the bottom: divide.
The signx is negative in quadrants 2 and 3.

faq.q: What does CAPS Grade 10 say about trigonometry?
faq.a: Define sin, cos and tan in right-angled triangles, their reciprocals, and extend the definitions to angles from 0° to 360°.

faq.q: Which ratio is negative in quadrant 2?
faq.a: cos and tan; sin is positive.

items.q: Which side is the hypotenuse, relative to the angle θ?
items.e: The hypotenuse is the longest side, opposite the right angle: Q.

items.q: Which side is the adjacent, relative to the angle θ?
items.e: The adjacent side is next to θ (and is not the hypotenuse): R.

items.q: Which side is the adjacent, relative to the angle θ?
items.e: The adjacent side is next to θ (and is not the hypotenuse): Q.

items.q: Which side is the hypotenuse, relative to the angle θ?
items.e: The hypotenuse is the longest side, opposite the right angle: X.

items.q: In a right-angled triangle, the opposite side is 4 cm and the adjacent side is 7 cm. Which ratio finds an angle?
items.e: SOH: sin = O/H. CAH: cos = A/H. TOA: tan = O/A. With the opposite side and adjacent side, use tan (TOA).

items.q: In a right-angled triangle, the opposite side is 12 cm and the hypotenuse is 18 cm. Which ratio finds an angle?
items.e: SOH: sin = O/H. CAH: cos = A/H. TOA: tan = O/A. With the opposite side and hypotenuse, use sin (SOH).

items.q: Which side is the opposite, relative to the angle θ?
items.e: The opposite side is across from θ: Z.

items.q: In a right-angled triangle, the adjacent side is 11 cm and the hypotenuse is 17 cm. Which ratio finds an angle?
items.e: SOH: sin = O/H. CAH: cos = A/H. TOA: tan = O/A. With the adjacent side and hypotenuse, use cos (CAH).

items.q: Which side is the opposite, relative to the angle θ?

items.q: In a right-angled triangle, the opposite side is 3 cm and the adjacent side is 4 cm. Which ratio finds the angle?
items.e: SOH: sin = O/H. CAH: cos = A/H. TOA: tan = O/A. With the opposite side and adjacent side, use tan (TOA).

items.q: θ is an acute angle and sin θ = 1213. Find cosec θ.
items.e: Draw the triangle: the sides are 5, 12 and 13 (hypotenuse). cosec θ = 1312. (cosec θ = 1 ÷ sin θ.)

items.e: Draw the triangle: the sides are 15, 8 and 17 (hypotenuse). sec θ = 1715. (sec θ = 1 ÷ cos θ.)
